text: Karim Adeyemi scored against Feyenoord. He settled the Levante match in stoppage time. Against Racing, he won two penalties and supplied Lamine's late goal. Those are different contributions in different situations: a finish, a decisive late intervention, and the ability to force mistakes and create for somebody else. Gabriel Jesus has also scored off the bench against both Feyenoord and Racing. This matters because opponents are not just preparing for Barcelona's starting eleven. They have to prepare for the next version of the attack. A game can be relatively controlled, then a substitution changes the speed, movement, or type of run they must deal with. That does not prove Barcelona have the best squad in Europe. Seven matches cannot prove that. It does show that this opening run has more behind it than one brilliant player carrying everyone else. But here comes the part the highlight reels can hide.
